TS2367.error: comparison with road-node has no overlap against the parcel-fact union
TS2367.mechanism: appliesToLinkFromPropertyAtom takes Pick<PropertyAtomInstance, entityType|entityId|parcelNodeId>. PropertyAtomInstance is the parcel-fact union and does not include RoadNodeAtomInstance. Road-node lives on StoredAtomInstance only. entityType === road-node is therefore unreachable.
TS2367.rejectedAlternative: Add RoadNodeAtomInstance to PropertyAtomInstance. That would widen the parcel-keyed write union and change who writePropertyAtomsBatch accepts. Rejected: road-node is not parcel-keyed (PARCEL_KEYED_PROPERTY_ENTITY_TYPES already filters it out).
TS2367.fix: Drop the dead road-node comparison. Keep parcel-node skip. Comment that road-node cannot reach this helper because it is not a PropertyAtomInstance.

TS2304.mechanism: export type { ParcelExternalKey } from @empressaio/atom-contract/property re-exports the name but does not introduce it into local scope. EnginePropertyPersistence.externalKeys uses it locally.
TS2304.rejectedAlternative: Invent a local ParcelExternalKey. Rejected: the contract type is the authority; a local alias would drift.
TS2304.fix: Add ParcelExternalKey to the existing import type block from @empressaio/atom-contract/property. Keep the re-export.
